winget-tui v0.15.0
A terminal UI for Windows Package Manager (winget).
📦 Downloads
──────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────
File                          │Platform
──────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────
winget-tui-x64.exe            │Windows x64
──────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────
winget-tui-arm64.exe          │Windows ARM64
──────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────
winget-tui-<version>-x64.zip  │Windows x64 portable ZIP for winget
──────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────
winget-tui-<version>-arm64.zip│Windows ARM64 portable ZIP for winget
──────────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────────
Highlights
- Batch uninstall from Installed: select packages with Space or a, then press x.
- Publisher and estimated-size columns, sortable headers, startup defaults, and CSV exports.
- Per-view caching restores selection, scrolling, filters and sorting when switching tabs.
- User/Machine install scope is shown and preserved on upgrades when uniquely detected.
- Signed x64 and ARM64 executables; portable ZIPs include the MIT license.
Usage
Download the executable for your platform and run it. No installation required.
